title: How a Godly Man Handles Being the Last Single Guy in the Friend Group
caption:
Wanting a wife isn't a lack of faith. It's how God wired you. The problem starts when the wanting gets louder than the God you say you're chasing.

Every engagement post that makes your stomach drop is data, not proof you're behind. It's proof you've started measuring your life on somebody else's calendar. The guy who spends his single years getting built, not just getting lonely, is the guy she can actually see coming.

You don't control the timeline. You control whether you're becoming a man worth marrying while you wait for it.

#faith #singleness #godlyman #christianmen #relationships
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
